title: Senior Frontend Engineer
text:
Brightlane is hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead the development of our customer dashboard.

This is a fully remote position; you must overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern time.

What you'll do
- Build accessible, fast interfaces with React and TypeScript.
- Own our design system together with the design team.
- Mentor other engineers.

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of professional frontend experience.
- Expert knowledge of React and TypeScript.
- Experience with state management (Redux or Zustand).
- Strong CSS skills; Tailwind CSS is a plus.
- Experience writing tests with Jest or Vitest and Testing Library.
- Excellent written communication in English.

Bonus points
- Experience with Next.js.
- GraphQL.
- Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG).

We offer equity, a home office budget and unlimited PTO.
